# Work

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Work>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)

A distinct abstract intellectual or artistic creation, independent of any language, notation, edition, or copy — the story, the composition, the visual conception. The most abstract tier of the WEMI spine; realized through one or more [`gmeow:Expression`](gmeow-Expression.md). Identity changes when the creative content itself differs.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](gmeow-CreativeWork.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Work`](gmeow-Work.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](gmeow-CreativeWork.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
